<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>S7 value decode failed</span></div>

## Why it happens

Wrong IP address, rack or slot, or PUT/GET access is not allowed in the CPU's protection settings. A decode failure means the data block, offset or data type does not match the PLC.

## Fix it

- Check IP address, rack and slot. S7-300: rack 0, slot 2. S7-1200, S7-1500 and LOGO!: rack 0, slot 1.
- In the CPU's properties, under **Protection & Security > Connection mechanisms**, tick **Permit access with PUT/GET communication from remote partner**, and clear **Optimized block access** on the data blocks you read.
- Check data block number, offset and type for decode failures.

## Check that it worked

Values arrive on the device.
